alt: A radio station: a streamlined two-storey cream Art Deco building with dark green tile bands, a tall tapering solid concrete mast topped with a steel ball, a curved glazed entrance with a canopy, round porthole windows and a small green-domed relay hut, on a paved square base plate

provenance.prompt: Isometric game building icon for a historical civilization strategy game: a radio station, a streamlined two-storey Art Deco building of pale grey concrete with rounded corners and horizontal bands of dark green tile, a tall tapering solid concrete mast rising from the roof topped with a small steel ball, a wide curved glazed entrance with a canopy, two round porthole windows and a small round relay hut with a domed roof beside it. One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no lattice tower, no open framework, no guy wires, no wires, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
